title: DASC Qwen3.6 Ascend piercing

paper.title: DASC: Decay-Aware State Compression for Hybrid Linear-Attention Serving

target.hardware_scope: current v12r32 controller targets physical NPU4-7; operator also authorizes physical NPU0-3 when a full live-process/HBM/container audit proves them idle

objective: Pierce DASC using the HYPIC-style evidence loop: method-chain parity, architecture fit, one-switch cache-hit A/B, Ascend correctness, matched performance, and E2E quality evidence.
delivery_constraint: Final runnable implementation must execute on Ascend through a plugin-owned monkeypatch path. Do not modify upstream vLLM, vLLM-Ascend, CANN, model weights, or original images; CPU/offline probes are only gates, not delivery.

latest_attempt.name: v12r31
latest_attempt.result: The dense-padding treatment never reached worker initialization or numerical requests. The service process failed during Ascend rtGetSocVersion/aclInit with Resource_Busy. Independent one-card probes failed on physical NPU4 and NPU7. A DIAS containerd task then exposed four Qwen3.5 VLLM workers on physical NPU4-7; after its exact task was stopped, a four-card allocation probe passed. This is environment-contention evidence, not a DASC result.

next_actions: Treat v12r31 as not_run/resource_race_before_readiness. It produced no DASC activation, state-row, numerical, performance, or quality evidence; do not accept or reject dense page padding from this attempt.

Run v12r32 only after its new DIAS containerd-task guard, the existing Docker/port/NPU/HBM guards, and the four-card allocation probe all pass. v12r32 keeps the exact v12r31 plugin bytes and changes only the immutable result identity plus resource-race guard.

Treat v12r30 as completed evidence: the exact 384-key all-layer row gate passed while strict numerical replay failed. Do not add more copy-row coverage or attribute the failure to missing middle layers.

Run the prepared v12r31 dense-page-padding identity control once on physical NPU4-7 after a fresh preflight. It must keep all v12r30 variables fixed and only restore the original dense page_size_padded reservation. Require 192 unique PID/layer physical-cache rows with payload bytes strictly below the dense reservation, plus the unchanged 384-key full-layer row gate and strict numerical canary.

If v12r31 passes, localize the defect to compact page geometry or aggregate offsets before designing the pruned layout. If it fails, close page padding and move to a one-variable attention-KV/aggregate-lifecycle control; do not continue expanding the same state-row trace.

Treat v12r29 as the completed matched dense eager control: three exact stopped VERIFIED responses, identical replays, and prefix_cache_hit_delta=3072. This clears eager execution itself and localizes the v12r28 failure to DASC physical-state or cache-lifecycle semantics.

Run the prepared v12r30 diagnostic once on physical NPU4-7 after a fresh preflight. Require the exact 4-rank x 48-layer x 2-state Cartesian set of 384 unique copy keys, one matching before/after native boundary pair per key, unchanged source rows, and updated destination rows. Preserve the strict numerical failure if it repeats; do not weaken the exact gate.

Do not reuse the terminal v12r20 root or idempotency key. The prepared v12r21 controller keeps the same one-variable state-index code in a new immutable root and adds fail-closed unknown-device-scope plus startup-window ownership guards.

Run v12r21 only after a fresh preflight returns ok. Operation exec-00000000000019e9 verified the checkpoint-derived 48-layer inventory and then rejected launch with NPU4-7 process-free at the 2868 MiB idle floor because Maxon4ick_torch_910_dev and alltoall-dedup-ep4_nk were running privileged with unknown physical-device scope. Do not stop, share, or silently allowlist them.

Treat v12r20 as not_run/resource_race_before_readiness: it emitted no state-row or numerical evidence, so the copied-row versus GDN metadata hypothesis remains untested and must not be accepted or rejected from this run.

Require v12r21 physical_state_copy_materialized, gdn_running_state_indices_remapped, and paired first_resumed_token_state_boundary events on all four TP workers. Each worker must cover both state families across the first and last representative GDN layers, every exact copy key must have exactly one before/after native boundary pair, the checkpoint-derived 48 GDN layers must be represented by the mapping event, the old source row must remain unchanged, the destination row must update, and the strict short/replay numerical canary must pass before pruning is restored.

Treat v12r19 as completed failed numerical evidence: all lifecycle branches were materially proven, so do not rerun v12r19, reuse its immutable root, or continue changing scheduler lifecycle selectors.

Treat v12r18 as a completed failed numerical experiment: lifecycle configuration flags were restored, but exact output and deterministic prefix replay still failed. Do not rerun the same bytes/root and do not benchmark or run E2E quality.

Keep the implemented fail-closed handling for running privileged containers with unknown device scope and monitor foreign PID/HBM ownership from the final prelaunch audit through readiness. A foreign late activation or HCCL bind collision must terminate only the owned launch and remain resource-race evidence.
Do not tune DASC retention, benchmark performance, or run E2E quality while the all-head control is nondeterministic.

Instrument the first cache-hit token boundary: capture request identity, local block mapping, compact source row, dense active-slot row, and state checksums before restore, before native recurrent execution, and after checkpoint.

Add a plugin-disabled dense lifecycle control and an all-head bridge control under the same long-prefix request sequence; require exact first-token logits or token IDs and stable state evolution before restoring pruning.

Treat v12r13 as the exact dense control: prompt_tokens=1938, identical_replays=true, all outputs VERIFIED, prefix_cache_hit_delta=3072, artifact SHA256 715aba4ddf6b9f35259034c96ea17051d66d350f20c71be83c54df48d20ce2d8.

Treat v12r14 and v12r15 as control-plane failures only: v12r14 exposed aligned mixed-group admission, and v12r15 copied an obsolete canary that did not accept the diagnostic gate. Neither is numerical evidence.

Treat v12r16 and v12r17 as decision-changing numerical evidence: all-head bridge and bridge-bypassed native-cache controls both remained unstable, so the bridge is not the sole cause. The next bounded hypothesis is mixed aggregate lifecycle awareness, not more bridge instrumentation.
Keep the verified dense-storage numerical canary as a closed reachability result; do not tune or benchmark it as a performance candidate.
Keep the immutable v12r4 root as a failed graph-capture result: real DASC activation passed, but the first-spec order was not instrumented and must not be inferred from model order.

Keep commit 373b448 and immutable v12r5 artifacts as the rejected first-spec dispatch attempt; the adapter fired on four ranks but storage_first and dispatch_first were already the same attention layer and graph capture failed identically.
Keep the failed adapter out of the active plugin tree while preserving its Git history.

Complete the paper-to-code parity matrix and label the current implementation paper-derived DASC-NR Ascend adaptation until an author repository is released or the missing SGLang mechanisms are independently reproduced.
Treat v12r6 as superseded: restoring compact state before every model forward violates the paper's cache-load boundary by erasing omitted-head updates accumulated after the first token.

Keep the integrated request-owned dense active-state bridge: a request keeps one stable dense slot across decode steps and physical block transitions; compact restore occurs only on true new/resumed prefix Load.

Keep the request-lifecycle regression gate: first Load zero-fills omitted heads, a normal step updates them, same-request block transition preserves them, and release/reactivate zero-fills them again while restoring retained heads.

Treat the TP4 MAX-padding tax as measured, not hypothetical: W_max=64 retains 1728 raw heads but stores 2084 after contiguous layerwise rank equalization. The exact whole-GQA-group TP4 bound is 1828; 1788 is only the arbitrary-per-head lower bound. If v12r7 is correct but weak, compare coupled group permutation against paper-equivalent variable-split Store/Load rather than tuning around the 1.11x temporal ceiling.

Use the operator-authorized DASC-local idle-claim override only when NPU4-7 have no device-side process and idle HBM. Record vllm_main_au, vllm_26_au and vllm_23_au declarations, never stop them, and fail closed if any real process or HBM allocation appears before launch.

Do not launch v12r6; its controller now fails closed on the semantic supersession. Prepare a newly named immutable attempt only after request identity, release/resume, metadata remapping, and graph-pointer gates pass.
Do not start formal performance or quality work unless a materially different successor passes service, strict canary, activation, ownership, and physical-byte verification.
Use commit 5f93b14 cache-hit quality adapter for formal quality runs; --require-cache-hit must fail closed on a zero hit delta.
Use the hash-pinned tokenizer context audit and max_model_len=44032 for both formal arms; reject truncation and the preserved invalid two-token audit.
Only after a materially different successor passes the physical mechanism gate, run the one-switch cache-hit TTFT and input-throughput benchmark.

successor.v12r19_readiness_gate: Superseded by the completed v12r19 NPU result: branch coverage passed, strict numerical replay failed, and no performance or E2E quality work was admitted.
successor.v12r20_readiness_gate: Terminal not_run/resource_race_before_readiness. Software preparation remained valid, but foreign unknown-scope container alltoall-dedup-ep4_nk activated on NPU4-7 during startup and caused an HCCL 16666 bind collision. No lifecycle, state-row, numerical, performance, or quality evidence was produced; the state-index hypothesis remains untested.
successor.v12r21_startup_guard: The operator-authorized physical NPU4-7 run completed without a resource race and failed the strict numerical canary. A later evidence audit corrected the initial verdict: the only gdn_running_state_indices_remapped event per worker was emitted before the physical copy and showed 12->12, while the first resumed-token boundary actually showed native metadata row 25 remapped to destination row 3. The physical copy itself used manager rows 2->3. Because the aggregate attention-first cache exposes 12 virtual kernel blocks per 1536-token manager block, raw GDN metadata row 25 normalizes to manager row 2. The real defect was failure to normalize kernel block ids during ordinary GDN execution, which caused state writes to rows such as 12/25 while the Mamba copy lifecycle read manager rows such as 1/2. Strict replay still failed and no performance or quality test was admitted.
successor.v12r22_readiness_gate: Plugin-only fix normalizes every live Ascend GDN metadata block id by input_batch.block_table[0].blocks_per_kv_block before native execution, then applies the copied running-state destination. Evidence distinguishes baseline normalization from an active copy remap and records raw source, normalized source, destination, and scale. The state-row verdict ignores pre-copy identity events and requires every exact copy boundary to match normalized source and destination rows. The software gate passed 189 tests and the 26-skill maintainer tree validation. The physical NPU4-7 launch then stopped fail-closed before readiness as not_run/resource_race: four target-card PIDs appeared that were absent from docker top's owned PID set. They disappeared when the owned container was stopped, so provenance remains ambiguous and no numerical, performance, or quality claim exists.
successor.v12r23_readiness_gate: Terminal not_run/resource_race_before_readiness. The enriched identity capture proved that foreign PID 3277916 was python3 /tmp/opencode/repro_foreach.py in cgroup /docker/321c36f70aac... and container Maxon4ick_torch_910_dev, occupying physical NPU4. This was not an owned DASC multiprocessing attribution gap. No numerical, performance, or quality claim exists.
successor.v12r24_readiness_gate: Same v12r23 algorithm, strict numerical gate, and fail-closed identity capture, with a new immutable root after the operator-authorized stop of the exact proven interfering containers. Docker initially could not create a new overlay because the host kernel mount-max was 100000 with about 98486 already consumed. Stopping alltoall-dedup-ep4_nk released enough mount budget; a fresh no-device v0.23 container then passed its focused test. v12r24 therefore uses a new dedicated container with only physical NPU4-7 mapped and does not reuse or mutate another task's container.
